attchmntText: Williamson Magor & Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of Board Meeting - Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Williamson Magor and Co Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Statutory auditors V Singhi and Associates issued a qualified review report. The report cites material uncertainty regarding going concern due to fully eroded net worth. The company lacks NBFC registration from RBI. Interest expenses on secured borrowings from HDFC Bank and inter-corporate borrowings totaling Rs 1,08,649 thousand were not recognized. Defaults exist on repayment of principal and interest for debt securities issued to IL&FS Financial Services Limited. Proceeds of Rs 9,02,500 thousand from Neemrana land sale will settle these dues. Deferred tax assets of Rs 10,83,981 thousand are overstated. Bank statements for HDFC Bank were unavailable for verification. Trade receivables and creditor balances lack reconciliation. The company reported a comprehensive loss for the period.
